map.Theta 为负代表什么？: What does a negative Theta mean?
map.买方 Theta 通常为负，表示每过一天时间价值流失；卖方则反之，靠时间衰减获利: Theta is usually negative for a buyer, meaning time value is lost each day; for a seller it is the opposite, profiting from time decay.
map.Vega 高有何风险？: What is the risk of a high Vega?
map.Vega 高说明价格对波动率敏感，波动率下降会侵蚀买方价值；卖方需防波动率跳升。: A high Vega means the price is sensitive to volatility, so a volatility drop erodes the buyer’s value; the seller must guard against volatility spikes.
